subject: Pilot kickoff — quick check and help to unblock
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah@lumaai.com>, Tom Greer <tgreer@lumaai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot kickoff — quick check and help to unblock

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through the pilot scope — appreciated. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned:

- Goal: Validate inference latency and cost on a representative subset of Luma's image-captioning traffic (10k requests/day simulated).
- Timeline: 2-week pilot (decoupled testing + metrics review).
- Redwood deliverables: sandbox deployment (access + small dataset), SE session for agent install, mutual action plan (attached).
- Luma deliverables: provide S3 read access to sample data, whitelist our IP for the sandbox, and point SE at the test cluster.

Next concrete items I have on my side:
1) I attached the mutual_action_plan.pdf that lists who is responsible for each step and target dates.
2) Priyom will join the install call; propose Wed 11/30 or Thu 12/1 for a 45-minute install clinic.
3) Marissa will kick off the evaluation dashboard and measurement plan once the sandbox is up.

If those times don't work, tell me a couple windows and we'll adapt. If you run into permission issues during the install, reply to this thread and Priyom can remote-in.

Attachments: 20261125-mutual_action_plan.pdf

Thanks,
Ben

- Can you share a short SOC2 summary and the data handling checklist we discussed? Procurement wants that before we provide S3 access.
- For the install clinic, Thu 12/1 10:00 PST might work for us — can you confirm?

I'll loop in procurement separately if I need approvals earlier.

Best,

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah@lumaai.com>, Tom Greer <tgreer@lumaai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — quick check and help to unblock

Sarah — checking in since we haven't seen any sandbox activity yet. We want to make the first week of the pilot as frictionless as possible and can help reduce lift on your infra team. Quick options to move forward:

A) 30-minute "install clinic" this week (fast path: agent + permissions) — Priyom and I will be on the call and can remote into your test host. Proposed slots: Tue 12/1 10:00 or Wed 12/2 14:00 PST.
B) If infra bandwidth is low, we can provision a temporary, redwood-managed sandbox (no production data) you can access immediately — takes ~2 hours to spin up.
C) If procurement needs the SOC2 doc first, I attached a concise SOC2-summary-2026.pdf and the data handling checklist link here: https://drive.redwood.com/quickstart.

We want to avoid waiting two weeks and not getting measurable telemetry. If priority has shifted on your side, please let us know and we can adjust the pilot timeline or provide a smaller scoped smoke test.

Attachments: SOC2-summary-2026.pdf

— Ben
From: Sarah Lim <sarah@lumaai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Greer <tgreer@lumaai.com>, procurement@lumaai.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 16:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — quick check and help to unblock

Sorry for the radio silence — we've been tied up with quarter-end priorities and Tom is leading the infrastructure freeze. We still want to run the pilot, but two updates:

1) Priority has slipped for the infra team — any install work will be delayed until mid-December.
2) Procurement would prefer a sandbox that uses synthetic telemetry (no customer PII) so they can sign off faster.

Can you (a) confirm whether Redwood can spin up a synthetic-data sandbox we can access without touching our prod S3, and (b) give a 1–2 hour window next week where Priyom can run the install remotely? If you can provide a minimal-scope smoke test today, that would help me show value to procurement.

Thanks,
Sarah
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah@lumaai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Tom Greer <tgreer@lumaai.com>, procurement@lumaai.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 10:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — quick check and help to unblock

Appreciate the update, Sarah. We can absolutely run a synthetic-data sandbox and spin it up today — it'll be isolated from any Luma infra and use only generated telemetry. Two suggested next steps so we can restart cleanly:

1) We spin a synthetic sandbox (no prod data) by EOD today and share credentials + a short runbook.
2) Priyom runs a 45-minute remote install clinic next Tue 12/8 09:00 PST (or Wed 12/9 14:00 PST) — pick whichever works.
3) To help procurement move faster, we can provide a 30-day evaluation credit and a concise security FAQ tailored for the sandbox.

If that sounds good I'll have the sandbox link and runbook to you in a few hours. If priority has dropped and you'd rather pause, tell us and we'll reschedule — no pressure.

Attachments: 20261125-mutual_action_plan.pdf, SOC2-summary-2026.pdf

— Ben
